answer: Topographic LiDAR attestation helps autonomous agent economies resist Sybil attacks. Drones authenticate by matching elevation point clouds against known geological formations, including a desert mesa, a rocky ledge, and dark onyx outcroppings. Generating forged identities requires adversaries to commit scarce capital and fuel to operate discrete aerial sensor rigs at dispersed coordinates. Nevertheless, airborne dust scatters laser pulses and distorts surface geometry, inadvertently denying verification to legitimate agents.
